text:
alex: FYI I just noticed a small but consistent tail-latency bump after merging the paged+flash fusion hotpatch (PR: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pull/4567). Can someone run a quick microbench? :thinking:
bench-bot: ran bench job r-8245 for alex: model=gpt2, seq=2048, batch=1, iters=50 -> p99 increased from 210ms -> 235ms (+11%). details: /artifacts/r-8245/log.txt
morgan: ack. I can run the same locally on A100-80. Quick question: are we comparing with the same kernel variant? the patch switched to fused_attn_v2 by default.
priya: that matches my quick smoke: on my dev node p95 is the same but p99 moved. looks like a small number of outliers. I captured nvprof traces.
dan: pinging @morgan and @sasha — can you try running with the legacy fused_attn enabled? i.e. set KERNEL_FALLBACK=1 and re-run. if that regresses back to previous numbers we know it's kernel-specific.
sasha: running now. command i used: 
```
./tools/run_microbench.sh --model gpt2 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --iters 50 --kernel fused_attn_v1
```
bench-bot: sasha's run (a-211): p99=208ms, p50=28ms, mean=35ms. seems back to baseline.
morgan: confirmed: with fused_attn_v1 p99 ~ 209ms. with v2 p99 ~235ms. attaching small diff of op timings.
priya: looks like the KV cache merge loop added an extra memcpy for odd sequence lengths. I can reproduce locally when seq % 128 != 0.
alex: good find. @priya can you gist the snippet or push a small repro test to the perf-tests suite? add a seq=2016 case (not multiple of 128)
priya: will do, pushing PR to add testcase and a guard. PR: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pull/4570 (draft). includes nvprof snapshot and a small code comment.
dan: TL;DR plan: 1) add regression test into perf-tests 2) run canary on Dedicated pool with fused_attn_v2 disabled by default 3) revert hotpatch if we see no quick fix. OK? :thumbsup:
morgan: also let's run quantized kernel variant to ensure this isn't amplified there. I'll queue a run on the Q8 nodes.
sasha: re: canary, I can spin up a 6-instance canary and route 1% traffic. canary config: 
```
route: canary/attn-fusion-v2
capacity: 6gpus
traffic: 1%
fallthrough: legacy
```
alex: great. if perf-tests + fix from @priya passes we'll try rolling into canary tonight CET. if not, revert and open follow-up. anyone opposed?
priya: no objections. I'll prioritize the guard and tests. ETA 3h.
morgan: I'll post updated bench numbers when q8 run finishes. also adding NVTX ranges to the runtime to get finer breakdowns in the next run.
bench-bot: queued job q-9142 for morgan on q8 nodes. link: /jobs/q-9142
dan: note for postmortem: call out odd-seq memcpy cost in changelog and link to perf-tests case.
alex: thanks all. leaving this thread open for updates. if we don't have an actionable fix by EOD we'll revert the merge. :eyes:
